action_items: P0 BRAND FIX: Replace 'SA Coparents' with 'SA CoParents' (or equivalent) in these 7 user-facing files: AppShell.jsx:97, Login.jsx:98, Register.jsx:72, Orientation.jsx:162, CancelSubscription.jsx:20, MediatorBadge.jsx:140, Watch.jsx:253. Also fix Watch.jsx:253 which uses a different markup pattern: `SA Coparents` — same lowercase-p issue.

critical_code_review_comments: public/index.html changes require a frontend supervisor restart to take effect (HtmlWebpackPlugin caches the template at dev-server start). Before the restart, the served index.html was the old 68-line default with no canonical/JSON-LD/robots meta. After `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` all SEO markers appeared. Main agent should be aware of this whenever public/index.html is edited.
Brand rename effort missed the .jsx wordmark pattern `SA Coparents` — a broader grep for `\bCoparents\b` (not just 'SA Coparents' as a full phrase) would have caught these 7 files.

rca of the issue: RCA (brand P0): Rename effort focused on the exact string 'SA Coparents' (as a full contiguous phrase) inside strings/text nodes. It missed JSX patterns where the wordmark is split across elements — e.g. `SA Coparents` — because 'SA Coparents' is not a substring of the source file (only 'Coparents' is). A grep for 'SA Coparents' as run in verification (which returns 0 hits) gives a false-clean signal. Correct grep: `grep -rEn '>[[:space:]]*Coparents\b|SA<[^>]*>[[:space:]]*Coparents' /app/frontend/src/`. Reproduction: log in as parent1@test.com → land on /orientation or navigate to /summary → header top-left visibly reads 'SA Coparents'. Mitigation: apply the 7 targeted edits listed in action_items; retest with the broader regex.
